standouts.head: A bull flag
standouts.text: It ran +25% in 14 sessions, then drifted for 4 sessions on lighter volume, giving back 37% of the run: a pause that often precedes the next leg.
standouts.learn: A sharp move (the pole), then a shallow drift on light volume (the flag); the next leg often matches much of the pole.

standouts.head: A smooth, steady uptrend
standouts.text: Over three months price has climbed +36% along a steady line (fit 0.89 of 1): an orderly trend, not a spike.
standouts.learn: How closely price has tracked a straight line; steady trends tend to persist, spikes tend to fade.

standouts.head: Holding its rising 20-day

standouts.head: Momentum holding a bull range

standouts.head: Quiet selling on the dip

against.head: MACD just turned down
against.text: MACD crossed below its signal line on Oct 22, above zero: an early turn.
against.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; crossing above its signal line means momentum is turning up.

against.head: A pullback that is not done
against.text: The pullback from the Oct 14 high is not done: it has not reached the 0.5 retracement and it is too quick for the advance before it. A wave 2 usually takes three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the Feb 27–Oct 14 advance (−36% to −47%).
against.learn: A real wave 2 takes three waves and time, on lighter volume. Too shallow, too quick, one straight leg or rising selling says it has further to go.

DINO.take: DINO: it is in an uptrend on every average; the buy waits for a daily close above the Oct 14 high, the first sign the pullback is over. There is a bull flag, and it is in a smooth, steady uptrend. Against it, MACD just turned down. The desk is for it.
DINO.change: Until a daily close above +6.7%, the pullback is intact and there is no trade; once in, a daily close below +2.7%, under the Oct 14 high, proves it wrong.

material.head: Broke down from a 9-week base
material.text: It closed below the bottom of a 9-week base on 1.8x average volume. 2 of the 2 closes from the break on held below the level it broke, and the break session closed 1.4 ATR past it on a 2.3-ATR range: a stretched spike.

material.head: Uptrend broken: under its last swing low
material.text: The swings had been climbing, but price has closed under the last swing low (Oct 1): the run of higher lows is broken.

material.head: Support −1.3% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −1.3% below (0.3 ATR), where 4 levels of 2 kinds meet: the Jul 29 low, the 50-week average and the February breakout level.

material.head: Below its averages
material.text: Price has slipped below both its 50-day and 200-day averages.

why: it is in a downtrend on every average

plan.sentence: Buy only after a daily close above +8.9% from the Oct 23 close, up to +11%. Target +21%. Once in, out on a daily close below +2.8%.

plan.why_t1: the Nov 7, 2025 low and the Nov 14, 2025 low

DY.gist: A falling stock; the buy comes only when it clears the Jun 9, 2025 high.

standouts.head: A hammer at a support area
standouts.text: On Oct 23 it dipped and closed near its high, leaving a long lower wick at a support area: buyers rejected the lows after a decline.
standouts.learn: A candle with a long lower wick and a close near the high: buyers rejected the lows.

standouts.head: Stretched below its 50-day
standouts.text: Price is 5.7 ATR below its 50-day average (−24% away), among its widest gaps of the year: moves this stretched tend to pause or snap back.
standouts.learn: How far price sits from its 50-day average in ATR; far stretches tend to pause or snap back.

against.head: Downtrend on every average
against.text: Price is below its falling 50-day and 200-day averages, and the 50-day is below the 200-day.
against.learn: Price below its falling 50-day and 200-day averages, the 50-day below the 200-day: the long trend points down.

against.head: Weekly chart: declining
against.text: On the weekly chart price is below a falling 30-week average: the declining stage.
against.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; the advancing stage (above a rising 30-week average) is where longs pay.

against.head: Near a 52-week low
against.text: Price set a new 52-week low on Oct 23 and closed 4.3% over it (0.7 ATR).
against.learn: The lowest price of the past year.

DY.take: DY: it is in a downtrend on every average; the buy waits for a daily close above the Jun 9, 2025 high, the first sign the decline is over. There is a hammer at a support area, and it is stretched below its 50-day. Against it, it is in a downtrend on every average. The desk stays out until the trigger's close says otherwise.
DY.change: Until a daily close above +8.9%, the decline is intact and there is no trade; once in, a daily close below +2.8%, under the Jun 9, 2025 high, proves it wrong. The case against, that it is in a downtrend on every average, fails on a daily close above +32%, the 50-day average.
